{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet blazer in midnight blue (#0a0e14), tailored fit with a single-button front and notched lapels.
Silk-blend midi slip dress in emerald green (#043825), fluid silhouette that drapes from the shoulders to mid-calf length.
Leather ankle boots in polished oxblood (#631c20), pointed toe with a moderate stiletto heel.
Delicate gold bar necklace in 18k vermeil with a matte finish and matching stud earrings in brushed gold.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance between casual elegance and festive polish for a bachelorette party on an autumn evening. The velvet blazer provides sophisticated warmth without feeling too formal, while the emerald slip dress introduces a pop of rich color that complements her warm skin tones. The pointed-toe boots extend the leg line visually, creating a streamlined silhouette appropriate for dancing and socializing in low artificial light. Overall, the combination of textures and deep jewel tones ensures she looks both relaxed and intentionally dressed-up for the celebration."}
